rooms.description: A continuous band of slanted windows frames grey breakers and backlights the compact console. Green radar rings punctuate dark navigation and weather screens. A clipped ledger, docked radio handset and cork noticeboard line the rear bulkhead.
rooms.feeling: Vigilant and exposed to the gale.

rooms.description: From just above the gritty anti-slip deck, steel bench legs frame squat pumps, a clear sampling manifold and looping teal water lines. A ceiling strip flashes white on the steel and picks out condensation on racked sample bottles.
rooms.feeling: Close, clammy and humming with pump vibration.

rooms.description: Seen from chair height, a two-by-three wall of blue monitors floats above a straight bolted desk. Workstation towers sit beneath matching bays. Bare pencil plots pinned between the screens and keyboards catch the glow.

From above, a round bolted table fills the foreground, ringed with mismatched mugs and old coffee stains. A yellow ceiling diffuser warms the galley counter, half-full coffee pot and snapshot-covered corkboard beside the scuffed refrigerator.
rooms.feeling: Familiar and warm, with breakfast interrupted.

rooms.description: The narrow hatch frames a clear rectangle of pale vinyl and an examination bed under a circular lamp. Flush cabinets with recessed latches flank a diagnostic workstation. A report folder lies square on a shallow desk.

Four narrow cabin doors per side repeat down a short passage, their steel jambs converging on a blank end bulkhead. One door stands ajar, spilling amber light over a bunk corner and across the dark rubber runner.
rooms.feeling: Quiet and intimate, with others close by.

rooms.description: Past an empty chair back, a diagonal counter holds an open laptop, two canted monitors and headphones draped over a camera. Violet screen light catches tangled charging leads and pinned rows of hand-drawn shot thumbnails.

From the corner, a red bench vise juts forward below a full-height toolboard and stacked parts bins. A caged work light throws hard wrench shadows across a pinned schematic, a test meter and the recessed maintenance terminal.
rooms.feeling: Loud, solid and ready for repair.

people.description: Broad at the shoulders and trim at the waist, he leans back in a crisp charcoal blazer with a burgundy pocket square. Side-parted silver hair frames a long face. He meets the eye, one palm open.
people.feeling: Polished and persuasive, with impatience just under the courtesy.

people.description: Tall and straight-backed, she wears a buttoned navy uniform shirt. A hard sidelight defines close-cropped curls, a square jaw and level brows. She looks past the viewer with her hands clasped behind her back.

Narrow-shouldered and fuller at the hips, she stands half-turned in a teal fleece over a long shirt, hands folded low. Backlight rims her short black bob as her tired eyes track sideways above a small, warm smile.
people.feeling: Approachable and observant, holding her composure through fatigue.

people.description: Stocky, with thick forearms, he hunches into a pool of light in grease-marked coveralls with orange stitching. Short grizzled hair and heavy stubble frame his blunt features. He looks down as he wipes his knuckles.
people.feeling: Tired, matter-of-fact and quietly proud of the work.

people.description: Seated, slight and round-shouldered, she wears a loose lilac scrub top. Diffuse light softens her freckled cheeks and low auburn bun. Her curved forearm brings two fingertips to her cheek while she listens off to one side.
people.feeling: Patient and discreet, comfortable leaving space for a pause.

people.description: Lanky, with a pointed chin and springy blond curls, he leans in at an angle in a loose mustard hoodie, a compact camera pulled against one rib. Screen glow catches his raised eyebrows as he looks up.
people.feeling: Restless curiosity and the eagerness to start a conversation.
